strategic_capability_mapping.transition: Task admission, running-deadline/admission, mode resolution, and external ModePack provenance denial ledger payloads move from versioned-open payload contracts to strict typed validation with v1 through v8 read compatibility.
strategic_capability_mapping.why_now: The remaining protocol-event-canonization blocker is full LedgerEvent payload typing. Task admission and mode-resolution events are the next bounded family because they preserve task creation/running provenance, selected mode policy evidence, Runtime-wide deadline evidence, and fail-closed external ModePack provenance denial decisions used by resume and replay.
strategic_capability_mapping.evidence: brownie-store validates strict TaskStarted, TaskRunning, ModeResolved, ExternalModePackChildProvenanceDenied, and ExternalModePackTaskProvenanceDenied payload fields before append/read, preserves legacy v1 through v8 payload-envelope read compatibility, and the generated semantic contract records strict_typed closed status for those families.
strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Narrows the protocol-event-canonization release blocker with strict typed task admission and mode-resolution ledger payload contracts so autonomous runs can depend on bounded admission/mode evidence during resume and replay.

answers.strategic_capabilities: RRP-5.13 advances protocol-event-canonization by moving task admission, task running deadline/admission, mode-resolution, and external ModePack provenance denial ledger event families to strict typed payload validation while preserving explicit release-blocking debt for remaining open payload families.
answers.new_capability: New TaskStarted, TaskRunning, ModeResolved, ExternalModePackChildProvenanceDenied, and ExternalModePackTaskProvenanceDenied payloads reject unknown fields, malformed field types, missing bounded admission/mode evidence, wrong fixed denial status values, and unbounded raw task/mode authority fields before durable append/read.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: RRP-5.12 made task/LLM lifecycle events strict typed, but task admission and mode-resolution events still accepted arbitrary versioned-open payloads despite carrying Runtime admission, selected mode policy, deadline, and external ModePack provenance-denial evidence.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie could still record task admission, running deadline, mode resolution, or external ModePack denial evidence with arbitrary or malformed fields while claiming protocol-event-canonization progress.
answers.non_duplicative: This is the RRP-5.13 task admission and mode-resolution event-family slice; it does not repeat RRP-5.5 inventory, RRP-5.6 known-field checks, RRP-5.7 terminal task typing, RRP-5.8 core permission typing, RRP-5.9 selected tool admission typing, RRP-5.10 MCP/tool terminal typing, RRP-5.11 Codebase Index/verification context typing, RRP-5.12 task/LLM lifecycle typing, RRP-7.2 durability/deadline work, or CI workflow hardening.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. RRP-5.13 adds no JSON-RPC method and only hardens durable ledger payload validation plus generated contract evidence.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The generated semantic contract and audit files are guard evidence, not a new user-facing Runtime summary surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Ledger appends with payloads for task start, task running/deadline admission, mode resolution, and external ModePack provenance denial events now use strict schemas, reject additional fields, and validate required bounded admission/mode evidence before writing or reading.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless resume/replay gains stronger admission and mode evidence because task start/running, selected mode, and external ModePack denial ledger payloads are no longer versioned-open during new writes.
answers.milestone_progress: Narrows protocol-event-canonization from 41 to 36 release-blocking open payload families while keeping Runtime Release Ready false until remaining payload families, runtime-release-guard-ci, and owner license/publish/release decisions are resolved.
